international.summary: Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Hanson ‘delighted’ to welcome Blyth Pauline Hanson has released a statement this morning welcoming South Australian senator Leah Blyth to her party. Senator Blyth will be One Nation’s first South Australian Senator and will build on One Nation’s expanding support within the state. My team and I are delighted to welcome Senator Blyth to sit in the Senate with One Nation. We are facing at the next election clearly a coalition of the Liberals, Nationals and One Nation, with all the baggage that each of these parties brings to the table.
